title: All-hands Q1 2026 update — draft talking points & Q&A
content:
Purpose / audience:
- Draft for company all-hands (entire company). Primary goal: align on Q1 priorities, share progress on Dedicated & Private launches, and surface the hybrid work update (pilot changes). Secondary: give visibility into hiring and org changes, and surface a few ask-of-teams (product telemetry, evals, promo nominations).

High-level talking points (for CEO intro):
1) Quick wins & metrics (30–45s each)
   - Hosted: 3x reduction in 95th p99 latency for small-chat profile since Jan (engineering metrics / RL).
   - Dedicated: 10 enterprise customers onboarded in pilot; two contracts signed (Feb) for Dedicated reserved capacity.
   - Private: first on-prem PoC completed with compliance audit pass (internal case study in progress).
   - Usage growth: platform tokens up ~28% QoQ; average revenue per active workspace up 9%.

2) Q1 product focus / roadmap (bullets)
   - Reduce tail latency for multi-tenant hosted endpoints (target: p99 -20% by end of Q1).
   - Rollout cost-optimization kit (Optimize) beta to top 50 customers — includes batching suggestions and quantization profiles.
   - Console: launch per-route tracing and token-level cost dashboards (beta).
   - Dedicated: increase autoscaling granularity and add burst credits feature.

3) Hybrid work / people ops update (short)
   - Pilot summary: we ran a 6-week hybrid pilot in Jan–Feb across Eng, Product, and DX. Feedback: 70% positive on focused collaboration days, 20% want more remote-first options.
   - Proposed change (ask for feedback in 2 weeks): official recommendation to adopt 3-in-office core days per sprint (team-specific flexibility), plus remote-first baseline.
   - Next steps: People Ops will publish proposed calendar, manager guidance, and a feedback form.

4) Hiring & org notes
   - Hiring ramp: hiring pause lifted for ICs in infra & SRE; ramping to 12 hires in Q2.
   - Promotions: leadership nominations open — deadline Mar 15.

5) Customer & compliance highlights
   - First private deployment audit passed (obs for customer reference).
   - Case study draft for large fintech customer — ops team to review for redaction.

Talking points: detailed speaker notes (for execs)
- CEO: 3x wins, why serving beats owning, top asks (support Dedicated pilots, feedback on hybrid proposal).
- CTO: technical win summary (latency, kernel selection improvements, KV cache efficiency), brief demo of trace dashboard (30s screenshot walk-through).
- Head of Product: roadmap bullets and what customers will see in next 60 days.
- Head of People Ops: hybrid pilot summary and where to give feedback.

Planned timeline for comms
- Draft exec slide deck by Mar 5.
- Review with execs Mar 6–7 (30m).
- Final deck and pre-reads to company Mar 9.
- All-hands Mar 12 (10:00 PT) + recording + follow-up survey.

Q&A (anticipated questions and suggested answers)
Q: "Will the hybrid change be mandatory?"
A: "No — recommendation is core days plus team-level flexibility. We want consistency for cross-team work while preserving remote options. Managers can propose team-specific schedules. People Ops will publish the guidance and a feedback window."

Q: "How will Dedicated pricing change with burst credits?"
A: "Burst credits are an add-on for sustained short-term spikes; baseline reserved capacity pricing remains the same. We'll publish an FAQ and examples. Product will run a pricing webinar for larger customers."

Q: "What does the Private deployment audit mean for our timeline?"
A: "It means we have a validated checklist for regulatory controls and can now scale PoCs faster. Expect two more pilot engagements in Q2."

Q: "Are we still hiring in 2026?"
A: "Yes — strategic hires in infra, SRE, and applied ML. We lifted the temporary pause for ICs on those teams. Recruiting will share role lists next week."

Unresolved / open items (notes to self)
- Confirm exact p99 latency number and owner to quote (ask: Priya in serving runtime).
- Get final Dedicated customer names approved by legal for mention.
- Slide with demo screenshot: need UX to capture trace dashboard scenario (Emily H to help).
- Hybrid pilot results doc: finalize summary and anonymize quotes.
- Decide who will own the post-all-hands survey and dashboard (Ops comms?)

Editorial / style notes
- Tone: optimistic, data-driven, humble. Avoid jargon-heavy deep technical slides in company-wide deck — surface wins, link to deep dive for eng team.
- Length: 25–30 minutes total talk time + 10–15 min Q&A. Keep exec segments to 3–4 bullets each.

Action items (short checklist)
- [ ] Priya: confirm latency metric and one-line explainer (due Mar 3).
- [ ] Legal: approve Dedicated customer mentions (due Mar 4).
- [ ] UX/Product: produce trace dashboard screenshot (due Mar 5).
- [ ] People Ops: publish hybrid proposal + feedback form (due Mar 9).
- [ ] Comms: finalize slides & send pre-read (due Mar 9).

Notes to self / scratchpad (informal)
- Think about opening anecdote: quick customer quote about predictability => ties to serving thesis.
- Keep a backup two-slide technical appendix for engineers in case we go deep.
- If time allows, highlight a quick customer quote about cost savings from Optimize beta.

References / links to backfill later:

Comments (for collaborators):

- Lucas: please confirm hiring counts & rough RFEs for infra roles.
- Samira: can you take the lead on the post-all-hands survey?

End of draft.
